bull.b: Strong subscription ARR growth combined with retention above 119% indicates customers are expanding their use of Rubrik’s platform. This recurring expansion supports durable revenue visibility, increases customer lifetime value, and reinforces the company’s position in enterprise cyber resilience.

Meaningful free cash flow alongside an approximately 80% gross margin shows improving economic quality in the core software model. Cash generation can fund research, product development, and sales investment internally while strong margins provide room for continued operating leverage.

Rapid growth among large customers and wins across regulated industries suggest Rubrik is increasing its strategic relevance within enterprise environments. Broader adoption across backup, identity, and resilience products can deepen relationships and create a more durable platform footprint.

bear.b: Negative equity combined with sizable debt weakens financial flexibility and makes the capital structure more exposed to execution setbacks. Although the company generates cash, leverage and the cumulative deficit can constrain capital allocation and increase the importance of sustained cash performance.

Rubrik has not yet converted its strong gross margin and recurring growth into GAAP profitability. Continued operating and net losses limit internally retained capital, require disciplined expense management, and leave the business dependent on further scale and efficiency gains to improve earnings durability.

bear.t: Cloud growth and new-product monetization uncertainty
bear.b: Slower cloud net new ARR and limited near-term contribution from Rubrik Agent Cloud create execution uncertainty beneath the broader growth story. As migrations wind down, Rubrik must sustain demand through newer products and non-cloud growth to maintain its overall expansion trajectory.
